name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by the Information Technology Department regarding the updated City Projects Application
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 30, 2019 Special Joint Meeting of the Encinitas City Council and the Encinitas Housing Authority, and the October 30, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-11-20 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-11-20 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Mobility Projects and Grants Update – Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Mobility projects and grants.
2019-11-20 Item 08C Mobility Projects and Grants Update
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Second Reading and Adoption of City Council Ordinances No. 2019-14, No. 2019-15, and No. 2019-16 for amendments to Title 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and the Local Coastal Plan to accommodate Supportive Housing, Transitional Housing, and Qualified Employee Housing (Ordinance No. 2019-14), include Reasonable Accommodation procedures (Ordinance No. 2019-15), and allow Single Room Occupancy Housing (Ordinance No. 2019-16) in compliance with state law requirements. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-14 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and the Local Coastal Plan, to Accommodate Qualified Employee Housing, Supportive Housing, and Transitional Housing in Compliance with State Law;" 2) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-15 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, and Local Coastal Plan, to Include Reasonable Accommodation Procedures to Comply with Fair Housing Laws;" and 3) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-16 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, the Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plan, the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan, the Encinitas Ranch Specific Plan, the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, and Local Coastal Plan, to Allow Single Room Occupancy Housing as a Permitted Use Where Multi-Family Residential Uses Are Permitted."
2019-11-20 Item 10A Adoption of Supportive, Transitional, and Employee Housing Ordinances
10B.
Introduction of Ordinance 2019-29 to Amend Municipal Code Chapter 23.40, Floodplain Management Regulations, to comply with Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) requirements. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Introduce Ordinance 2019-29 titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Municipal Code Chapter 23.40 - Floodplain Management Regulations."
2019-11-20 Item 10B Introduction of Ordinance 2019-29 Floodplain Management Regulations
10C.
Introduction of Draft Ordinance No. 2019-28 for amendments to the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan (DESP) and the Local Coastal Plan to revise the planting palette, location, and planting guidelines within Chapters 4 and 7 of the DESP. Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-28 titled "An Ordinance of The City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan to Address Changes to the Street Tree Guidelines. Case Number: PLCY 003379-2019 SPA/LCPA."
2019-11-20 Item 10C Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan Street Tree Amendment
10D.
Jewish Family Service requests to operate a Safe Parking Program on the Leichtag Foundation property located at 441 Saxony Road for 25 households living in their cars. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Receive presentation by Jewish Family Service and Leichtag Foundation regarding Safe Parking Program proposal and provide direction to staff.
2019-11-20 Item 10D Safe Parking Proposal
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Informational report on the status of the Leucadia North Highway 101 Streetscape Project and related projects including the El Portal Undercrossing. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Receive the oral report and provide direction as necessary.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - None
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON DECEMBER 11, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
